summary: Teaches how to monitor PostgreSQL with Grafana Alloy using the Cloud PostgreSQL integration, including install, config, testing, and prebuilt dashboards/alerts.

needs.description: Running PostgreSQL (>=9.5) with a monitoring user, plus optional log file (/var/log/postgresql/postgres.log).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "A running PostgreSQL instance (PostgreSQL >= 9.5)"

needs.description: Machine where Alloy is installed with the generated config; needed for Test connection to find data.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Access to the machine where you want to install Grafana Alloy"

needs.description: PostgreSQL integration available in Connections (/connections/add-new-connection/postgres); install-dashboards-alerts installs dashboards (overview, logs) and alert rules.
PostgreSQL exporter metrics (pg_*) and logs in Cloud Mimir/Loki so test-connection and Explore metric select list metrics.

reviewNotes: Integration install/dashboard steps work UI-only; test-connection depends on live data from Alloy.
